## Appendix Tables B.5 and B.6: ninth-grade entry and the lottery population

Appendix Table B.5 estimates both outcomes again on every grade and on the ninth grade alone (the
entry grade of the lottery analysis), each with its own 10,000 bootstrap draws (seeds `SEED_NINTH` +
1 to + 4) and pointwise 95% intervals; the point estimates on every grade are Table II's. Each
group-time effect is rebuilt from its four cell means, and the aggregation weights from did's group
masses. Appendix Table B.6 compares, in the regions and entering classes that give the ninth-grade
comparison a post-adoption effect, the ninth-grade entrants, the lottery applicants whose ranked
over-demanded schools (continuity options included) all lie there, and the students among them whose
attendance depends on the offer: their mean prior-year GPA, on the composition panel's scale (each
application year's 8th-grade average converted by the exact affine relation in the children found in
both files), and their low-income share. The complier means follow Abdulkadiroglu et al. (2017, p.
1402), within hundredth chance groups that hold both offer arms, with influence-function SEs. Writes
`tables/appendix_ninth_grade_composition.tex`, `tables/appendix_ninth_grade_profiles.tex` and, at
full precision, `numbers/ninth_grade_composition.csv`, `numbers/ninth_grade_composition_support.csv`
(each group-time effect behind the four estimates), `numbers/ninth_grade_gpa_conversion.csv` (by
entry year) and `numbers/ninth_grade_profiles.csv`. The composition, support and profiles files name
each row's units in a `units` column: SD for the GPA rows; for the low-income rows, percentage
points in the composition file, fractions (1 = 100 pp) in the support file and percent in the
profiles file.

```{r ninth-grade-tables}
# One did fit in the model process followed by the aggregations in `aggs`, each with its own arguments (did draws a multiplier
# bootstrap for each); returns the fit and the aggregations, and advances this process's random-number state, as fit_did does
bootstrap_model_aggs <- function(job) {
  assign(".Random.seed", job$rng, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  notes <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  notes$warnings <- character(0); notes$messages <- character(0)
  value <- withCallingHandlers(
    with_bootstrap_draws({
      fit <- do.call(did::att_gt, job$args)
      list(fit = fit, aggregates = lapply(job$aggs, function(a) do.call(did::aggte, c(list(MP = fit), a))))
    }, job$id, sort(unique(job$args$data$region))),
    warning = function(w) { notes$warnings <- c(notes$warnings, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
    message = function(m) { notes$messages <- c(notes$messages, conditionMessage(m)); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") })
  list(value = value, rng = .Random.seed, warnings = notes$warnings, messages = notes$messages)
}
environment(bootstrap_model_aggs) <- .GlobalEnv
fit_did_aggs <- function(d, id, aggs) {
  job <- list(id = id, aggs = aggs, rng = .Random.seed,
    args = list(yname = "y", tname = "yr", idname = "cell_id", gname = "G", data = d,
      control_group = "notyettreated", panel = TRUE, allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE,
      base_period = "universal", anticipation = 0L, bstrap = TRUE, biters = B_BOOT,
      clustervars = "region", cband = FALSE, print_details = FALSE))
  result <- tryCatch(clusterCall(model_worker, bootstrap_model_aggs, job)[[1L]],
    error = function(e) {
      try(stopCluster(model_worker), silent = TRUE)
      stop(e)
    })
  for (w in unique(result$warnings)) warning(sprintf("did (%s): %s", id, w), call. = FALSE)
  for (m in unique(result$messages)) message(sprintf("did (%s): %s", id, trimws(m)))
  assign(".Random.seed", result$rng, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  result$value
}
# A fit's post-adoption group-time effects: each rebuilt from its four cell means in `cells` (treated and not-yet-treated
# cells, in g-1 and t), and its weight in the overall effect from did's group masses; checks both against did
check_post_effects <- function(fit, overall, cells, yvar, tol_overall) {
  dp <- fit$DIDparams
  mass_data <- if (dp$panel) dp$data[dp$data$yr == min(dp$tlist), ] else
    stats::aggregate(dp$data, list(dp$data$cell_id), mean)[, -1]
  k <- which(fit$group <= fit$t & is.finite(fit$att))
  masses <- vapply(fit$group[k], function(g) mean(mass_data$.w * (mass_data$G == g)), numeric(1))
  weights <- masses / sum(masses)
  stopifnot("the weights sum to one" = abs(sum(weights) - 1) < 1e-10,
            "the weighted group-time effects give did's overall effect" = abs(sum(weights * fit$att[k]) - overall) < tol_overall)
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(k), function(j) {
    i <- k[j]; g <- fit$group[i]; t <- fit$t[i]; b <- g - 1L
    tb <- cells[G == g & yr == b & is.finite(get(yvar))]; tt <- cells[G == g & yr == t & is.finite(get(yvar))]
    cb <- cells[G > t & yr == b & is.finite(get(yvar))];  ct <- cells[G > t & yr == t & is.finite(get(yvar))]
    manual <- mean(tt[[yvar]]) - mean(tb[[yvar]]) - mean(ct[[yvar]]) + mean(cb[[yvar]])
    stopifnot("each group-time effect is its four cell means" = abs(manual - fit$att[i]) < 1e-8)
    data.table(g = g, t = t, weight = weights[j], estimate = fit$att[i],
               treated_regions = paste(sort(unique(c(tb$region, tt$region))), collapse = ","),
               control_regions = paste(sort(unique(c(cb$region, ct$region))), collapse = ","))
  }))
}

# Appendix Table B.5: every grade and the ninth grade, both outcomes, in the table's order; fit i uses the seed SEED_NINTH + i
ninth_designs <- list(all_grades = CP, ninth_grade = CP[cod_nivel == 9L])
ninth_specs <- data.table(design = rep(names(ninth_designs), each = 2L), outcome = rep(c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"), times = 2L))
ninth_specs[, label := paste(design, outcome, sep = "_")]
stopifnot("the table's order of the four fits" =
            identical(ninth_specs$label, c("all_grades_gpa_z", "all_grades_sh_prio", "ninth_grade_gpa_z", "ninth_grade_sh_prio")))
ninth_fits <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ninth_specs)), function(i) {
  spec_design <- ninth_specs$design[i]; spec_outcome <- ninth_specs$outcome[i]
  spec_cells <- ninth_designs[[spec_design]]
  d <- as.data.frame(spec_cells[is.finite(get(spec_outcome)), .(cell_id, yr, G, region, y = get(spec_outcome))])
  set.seed(SEED_NINTH + i)
  value <- fit_did_aggs(d, paste0("ninth_", ninth_specs$label[i]), list(list(type = "simple", na.rm = TRUE)))
  fit <- value$fit; agg <- value$aggregates[[1L]]
  scale <- if (spec_outcome == "sh_prio") 100 else 1
  list(support = data.table(design = spec_design, outcome = spec_outcome,
                            check_post_effects(fit, agg$overall.att, spec_cells, spec_outcome, 1e-10)),
       row = data.table(design = spec_design, outcome = spec_outcome, estimate = scale * agg$overall.att,
                        se = scale * agg$overall.se, lower = scale * (agg$overall.att - qnorm(.975) * agg$overall.se),
                        upper = scale * (agg$overall.att + qnorm(.975) * agg$overall.se),
                        observed_cell_years = nrow(fit$DIDparams$data)),
       first_year = as.integer(min(fit$DIDparams$data$yr)))   # the first year of the cell-years the fit uses (the table's note)
})
ninth_results <- rbindlist(lapply(ninth_fits, `[[`, "row"))
ninth_support <- rbindlist(lapply(ninth_fits, `[[`, "support"))
stopifnot("the note of Appendix Table B.5: the all-grade point estimates are Table II's" =
            abs(ninth_results[design == "all_grades" & outcome == "gpa_z", estimate] - g_reg$att) < 1e-12 &&
            abs(ninth_results[design == "all_grades" & outcome == "sh_prio", estimate] / 100 - p_reg$att) < 1e-12,
          "finite SEs" = all(is.finite(ninth_results$se)))
print(ninth_results)
print(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade"])
fwrite(copy(ninth_results)[, units := fifelse(outcome == "sh_prio", "percentage points", "SD")],
       file.path(NUM_DIR, "ninth_grade_composition.csv"))
fwrite(copy(ninth_support)[, units := fifelse(outcome == "sh_prio", "fraction (1 = 100 pp)", "SD")],
       file.path(NUM_DIR, "ninth_grade_composition_support.csv"))

b_num <- function(x, digits) no_minus_zero(sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x))   # never "-0.000"
b_row <- function(label, cells) paste0(label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n")
b_float <- function(caption, label, alignment, body, note) paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]\n\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}\n\\centering\n",
  "\\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}\n\\small\n",
  "\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", alignment, "@{}}\n",
  "\\toprule\n", body, "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular*}\n\\par\\smallskip\n",
  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize\nNotes: ", note,
  "\n\\end{minipage}\n\\end{table}")
# each specification's block of rows; a rule between the two blocks
composition_blocks <- vapply(c("all_grades", "ninth_grade"), function(spec) {
  r <- ninth_results[design == spec][match(c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"), outcome)]
  stopifnot("one row for each outcome" = identical(r$outcome, c("gpa_z", "sh_prio")))
  cells_txt <- function(column) mapply(b_num, r[[column]], c(3L, 2L), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  paste0(b_row(if (spec == "all_grades") "All grades" else "Ninth grade", cells_txt("estimate")),
         b_row("", paste0("(", cells_txt("se"), ")")),
         b_row("95\\% confidence interval", paste0("[", cells_txt("lower"), ", ", cells_txt("upper"), "]")),
         b_row("School-grade-years", comma_int(r$observed_cell_years)))
}, "")
composition_body <- paste0(
  b_row("Specification", c("\\shortstack{Prior-year GPA\\\\(SD)}", "\\shortstack{Low-income share\\\\(pp)}")),
  b_row("", c("(1)", "(2)")), "\\midrule\n", paste(composition_blocks, collapse = "\\midrule\n"))
# the note's years, from the fits: the entering classes of each specification's post-adoption effects, and the first year of the
# cell-years the four fits use; the note's sentence on the Metropolitan Region (region 13) holds when it is the one region that
# supplies ninth-grade comparisons and has no post-adoption effect of its own, and the knit stops on any other set of regions (the
# sentence names that region)
year_span <- function(t) {   # the first and last year, as the paper's notes print them
  stopifnot("whole years, none missing" = length(t) > 0L && !anyNA(t) && all(t == round(t)))
  sprintf("%d--%d", as.integer(min(t)), as.integer(max(t)))
}
stopifnot("year_span self-test: 2017--2019 from three years out of order; 2020--2020 from one; a missing year stops" =
            identical(year_span(c(2019, 2017, 2018)), "2017--2019") && identical(year_span(2020L), "2020--2020") &&
            inherits(try(year_span(c(2017, NA)), silent = TRUE), "try-error"))
regions_of <- function(x) sort(unique(as.integer(unlist(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)))))   # the regions of comma-separated lists
stopifnot("regions_of self-test" = identical(regions_of(c("1,13", "2,1", "13")), c(1L, 2L, 13L)))
span_all_grades <- year_span(ninth_support[design == "all_grades", t])
span_ninth_grade <- year_span(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", t])
ninth_comparison_only <- setdiff(regions_of(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", control_regions]),
                                 regions_of(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", treated_regions]))
if (!identical(ninth_comparison_only, 13L))
  stop("the note of Appendix Table B.5 says that in ninth grade the Metropolitan Region (13) is the one region that supplies ",
       "comparisons without a post-adoption effect of its own; with these data those regions are: ",
       if (length(ninth_comparison_only)) paste(ninth_comparison_only, collapse = ", ") else "none", call. = FALSE)
first_years <- unique(vapply(ninth_fits, `[[`, 0L, "first_year"))
stopifnot("the four fits' cell-years start in the same year" = length(first_years) == 1L)
composition_note <- paste0(
  "The outcomes and estimator follow Table~\\ref{tab: alloc headline}. ",
  "The ninth-grade specification restricts the sample to ninth-grade entrants. ",
  "Both specifications use not-yet-treated school-grades, a universal pre-adoption base period, ",
  "no additional covariates, and the unbalanced-panel estimator described in Appendix~\\ref{app:access}. ",
  "Within comparisons, school-grade cells receive equal weight; group-time effects are aggregated by adoption-group size. ",
  "The all-grade and ninth-grade estimates cover supported post-adoption entering classes in ", span_all_grades, " and ",
  span_ninth_grade, ", respectively. ",
  "For ninth grade, the Metropolitan Region supplies comparisons but has no identified post-adoption effect. ",
  "Observation counts include pre-adoption years from ", first_years, ". Region-clustered SE from ", comma_int(B_BOOT), " multiplier-bootstrap draws ",
  "are in parentheses; brackets report pointwise 95\\% intervals. All-grade point estimates reproduce the main table; ",
  "SE are recomputed with fresh draws. No permutation-test significance stars are reported. ",
  "The small number of regions remains a limitation for inference.")
# the note's statements about the support, checked: the entering classes each specification covers and the Metropolitan
# Region's place in the ninth-grade comparisons
text_claims("a footnote of the composition section and the note of Appendix Table B.5: the all-grade estimates cover the entering classes of 2017-2020" =
            identical(as.integer(range(ninth_support[design == "all_grades", t])), c(2017L, 2020L)),
          "the composition appendix's text on ninth-grade entry and the note of Appendix Table B.5: the ninth-grade estimates cover the entering classes of 2017-2019" =
            identical(as.integer(range(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", t])), c(2017L, 2019L)),
          "the composition appendix's text on ninth-grade entry and the note of Appendix Table B.5: in ninth grade the Metropolitan Region is never treated in a post-adoption effect and supplies comparisons" =
            !any(grepl("(^|,)13(,|$)", ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", treated_regions])) &&
            any(grepl("(^|,)13(,|$)", ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", control_regions])),
          "the note of Appendix Table B.5: the pre-adoption years start in 2012" = min(CP$yr) == 2012L)
write_tex(b_float("Entering-Class Composition at Ninth-Grade Entry", "tab: ninth grade composition",
                  "p{0.46\\textwidth}cc", composition_body, composition_note),
          "appendix_ninth_grade_composition.tex")

# Appendix Table B.6: the supported region-years of the ninth-grade comparison
od_region <- unique(EP[COD_NIVEL == 9L, .(RBD, REGION, G = DOOR + 1L)])
stopifnot("one region and adoption year per school with a ninth grade" = !anyDuplicated(od_region$RBD),
          "a footnote of the composition section: the schools with a ninth grade in the composition panel are the over-demanded schools of the school file, one for one" =
            setequal(od_region$RBD, OD_SCHOOLS))
support_gt <- unique(ninth_support[design == "ninth_grade", .(G = as.integer(g), ENTRY_YEAR = as.integer(t))])
support_region_year <- merge(unique(od_region[, .(REGION, G)]), support_gt, by = "G", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
text_claims("the composition appendix's text on ninth-grade entry: no supported region-year in the Metropolitan Region" =
            !any(support_region_year$REGION == 13L),
          "the composition appendix's text on ninth-grade entry: the last supported entering class is 2019" =
            max(support_region_year$ENTRY_YEAR) == 2019L)
supported_key <- paste(support_region_year$REGION, support_region_year$ENTRY_YEAR)

# the lottery applicants on the composition panel's GPA scale: each entry year's affine conversion, from the children found in
# both files, linked by student ID and entry year (the 9th-grade entrants of the composition panel; the applicants' application
# year + 1); each linked child's school in the composition panel is checked to be the school she attends in the lottery file
# (ENTRY_RBD)
ninth_entrants <- EP[COD_NIVEL == 9L]
profile_panel <- APPLICANTS[, .(YEAR, MRUN, LOTTERY_SAMPLE, OFFER, D_OD, CHANCE_GROUP, GPA8_Z, PRIORITARIO, ENTRY_RBD)]
profile_panel[, ENTRY_YEAR := YEAR + 1L]
linked_profiles <- merge(ninth_entrants, profile_panel, by.x = c("MRUN", "AGNO"), by.y = c("MRUN", "ENTRY_YEAR"))
stopifnot("a child found in both files enters the school she attends in the lottery file" = all(linked_profiles$RBD == linked_profiles$ENTRY_RBD))
gpa_conversion <- linked_profiles[complete.cases(PRIOR_GPA_Z, GPA8_Z), {
  m <- lm(PRIOR_GPA_Z ~ GPA8_Z)
  list(n_linked = .N, intercept = unname(coef(m)[1]), slope = unname(coef(m)[2]), maximum_residual = max(abs(resid(m))))
}, keyby = .(ENTRY_YEAR = AGNO)]
print(gpa_conversion)
stopifnot("the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.6: an exact affine relation in every entry year" =
            all(gpa_conversion$maximum_residual < 1e-8) && all(gpa_conversion$slope > 0))
fwrite(gpa_conversion, file.path(NUM_DIR, "ninth_grade_gpa_conversion.csv"))
profile_panel <- merge(profile_panel, gpa_conversion, by = "ENTRY_YEAR", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
stopifnot("a conversion for every entry year" = !anyNA(profile_panel$slope))
profile_panel[, GPA_COMPOSITION := intercept + slope * GPA8_Z]

# a constructed 0/1 gate: its share printed; the knit stops unless it takes both values (the flag() of the outcomes notebook)
flag <- function(x, what) {
  if (anyNA(x) || !all(x %in% 0:1) || length(unique(x)) != 2L) stop(what, ": a 0/1 flag taking both values expected", call. = FALSE)
  say("%s: share %.4f of %s", what, mean(x), format(length(x), big.mark = ","))
  invisible(x)
}

# each applicant's ranked over-demanded schools, their regions and whether every one lies in a supported region-year
od_choices <- data.table(MRUN = rep(APPLICANTS$MRUN, lengths(APPLICANTS$OD_CHOICES)),
                         YEAR = rep(APPLICANTS$YEAR, lengths(APPLICANTS$OD_CHOICES)), RBD = unlist(APPLICANTS$OD_CHOICES))
od_choices <- merge(od_choices, od_region, by = "RBD", all.x = TRUE)
od_choices[, ENTRY_YEAR := YEAR + 1L]
od_choices[, in_supported_region_year := paste(REGION, ENTRY_YEAR) %in% supported_key]
flag(od_choices$in_supported_region_year, "Appendix Table B.6, ranked over-demanded schools in a supported region-year")
choice_support <- od_choices[, .(all_choices_supported = all(in_supported_region_year)), by = .(MRUN, YEAR)]
profile_panel <- merge(profile_panel, choice_support, by = c("MRUN", "YEAR"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
profile_panel[is.na(all_choices_supported), all_choices_supported := FALSE]
flag(profile_panel[LOTTERY_SAMPLE == TRUE, all_choices_supported],
     "Appendix Table B.6, lottery children whose ranked over-demanded schools all lie in supported region-years")
# the ninth-grade entrants in the supported region-years
entrant_supported <- ninth_entrants[, paste(REGION, AGNO) %in% supported_key]
flag(entrant_supported, "Appendix Table B.6, ninth-grade entrants in a supported region-year")

# the complier mean of a characteristic within the hundredth chance groups that hold both offer arms, its influence-function
# SE, and the applicants' mean on the same children; checked against a weighted 2SLS with chance-group fixed effects
complier_profile <- function(applicants, v) {
  d <- copy(applicants[!is.na(get(v))])
  d[, X_PROFILE := get(v)]
  d[, DX := D_OD * X_PROFILE]
  means <- d[, .(ns = .N, q = mean(OFFER), d1 = mean(D_OD[OFFER == 1]), d0 = mean(D_OD[OFFER == 0]),
                 dx1 = mean(DX[OFFER == 1]), dx0 = mean(DX[OFFER == 0])), by = CHANCE_GROUP]
  supported_means <- means[q > 0 & q < 1]
  keep <- d$CHANCE_GROUP %in% supported_means$CHANCE_GROUP
  flag(keep, sprintf("Appendix Table B.6, %s: applicants in chance groups that hold both offer arms", v))
  n_dropped <- sum(!keep)
  d <- merge(d[keep], supported_means, by = "CHANCE_GROUP", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  first_stage <- sum(supported_means$ns * (supported_means$d1 - supported_means$d0)) / nrow(d)
  numerator <- sum(supported_means$ns * (supported_means$dx1 - supported_means$dx0)) / nrow(d)
  stopifnot("a positive first stage" = first_stage > 0)
  mu <- numerator / first_stage
  d[, psi_num := dx1 - dx0 + OFFER / q * (DX - dx1) - (1 - OFFER) / (1 - q) * (DX - dx0)]
  d[, psi_den := d1 - d0 + OFFER / q * (D_OD - d1) - (1 - OFFER) / (1 - q) * (D_OD - d0)]
  influence <- (d$psi_num - mu * d$psi_den) / first_stage
  se_mu <- sqrt(sum(influence^2)) / nrow(d)
  d[, iv_weight := 1 / (q * (1 - q))]
  # the check reads only the coefficient; the iid variance is the cheapest to compute
  check_iv <- feols(DX ~ 1 | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d, weights = ~iv_weight, vcov = "iid", fixef.rm = "none", nthreads = 1L)
  stopifnot("the weighted 2SLS gives the complier mean" = abs(unname(coef(check_iv)[1]) - mu) < 1e-8,
            "the influence function has mean zero" = abs(mean(influence)) < 1e-8)
  scale <- if (v == "PRIORITARIO") 100 else 1
  data.table(characteristic = v, population = c("Estimated complier profile", "Lottery applicants"),
             n = nrow(d), excluded_no_offer_overlap = n_dropped,
             mean = c(scale * mu, scale * mean(d$X_PROFILE)), se = c(scale * se_mu, NA_real_))
}
supported_applicants <- profile_panel[LOTTERY_SAMPLE == TRUE & all_choices_supported == TRUE]
supported_entrants <- ninth_entrants[entrant_supported]
profiles <- rbind(
  rbindlist(lapply(c("GPA_COMPOSITION", "PRIORITARIO"), function(v) complier_profile(supported_applicants, v))),
  rbindlist(lapply(c("PRIOR_GPA_Z", "PRIO"), function(v) {
    x <- supported_entrants[[v]]; x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    data.table(characteristic = if (v == "PRIO") "PRIORITARIO" else "GPA_COMPOSITION", population = "Ninth-grade entrants",
               n = length(x), excluded_no_offer_overlap = NA_integer_, mean = mean(x) * if (v == "PRIO") 100 else 1, se = NA_real_)
  })))
print(profiles)
fwrite(copy(profiles)[, units := fifelse(characteristic == "PRIORITARIO", "percent", "SD")], file.path(NUM_DIR, "ninth_grade_profiles.csv"))
say("lottery applicants in the supported region-years: %s; ninth-grade entrants there: %s",
    format(nrow(supported_applicants), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(supported_entrants), big.mark = ","))

profile_order <- c("Estimated complier profile", "Lottery applicants", "Ninth-grade entrants")
# each characteristic's three populations, in the columns' order
profile_rows <- lapply(c(GPA_COMPOSITION = "GPA_COMPOSITION", PRIORITARIO = "PRIORITARIO"), function(profile_v) {
  r <- profiles[characteristic == profile_v][match(profile_order, population)]
  stopifnot("one row for each population" = identical(r$population, profile_order))
  r
})
profile_means <- vapply(names(profile_rows), function(profile_v) {
  r <- profile_rows[[profile_v]]
  digits <- if (profile_v == "GPA_COMPOSITION") 3L else 2L
  paste0(b_row(if (profile_v == "GPA_COMPOSITION") "Prior-year GPA (SD)" else "Low-income (\\%)", b_num(r$mean, digits)),
         b_row("", c(paste0("(", b_num(r$se[1], digits), ")"), "", "")))
}, "")
profile_counts <- vapply(names(profile_rows), function(profile_v)
  b_row(if (profile_v == "GPA_COMPOSITION") "$N$, GPA" else "$N$, low-income", comma_int(profile_rows[[profile_v]]$n)), "")
profile_body <- paste0(b_row("", c("\\shortstack{Students whose\\\\attendance depends\\\\on the offer}",
  "\\shortstack{Lottery\\\\applicants}", "\\shortstack{Ninth-grade\\\\entrants}")),
  b_row("", c("(1)", "(2)", "(3)")), "\\midrule\n",
  paste(profile_means, collapse = ""), "\\midrule\n", paste(profile_counts, collapse = ""))
# the applicants each characteristic's sample leaves out (chance groups without both offer arms), one count for each
excluded <- vapply(profile_rows, function(r) r$excluded_no_offer_overlap[2L], 0L)
stopifnot("one count for GPA and one for income, neither missing" =
            identical(names(excluded), c("GPA_COMPOSITION", "PRIORITARIO")) && !anyNA(excluded))
profile_note <- paste0(
  "The samples cover the regions and ", year_span(support_region_year$ENTRY_YEAR), " entering cohorts contributing treated observations to ",
  "Table~\\ref{tab: ninth grade composition}. Lottery applicants are retained when every over-demanded school ",
  "on their pre-lottery list, including automatic continuity options, belongs to a supported region-cohort. ",
  "No restriction uses the realized offer or school attended. Columns (1) and (2) use the same observed-characteristic ",
  "sample and retain hundredth propensity-score groups containing both offer arms; this excludes ",
  comma_int(excluded[["GPA_COMPOSITION"]]), " applicants for GPA and ",
  comma_int(excluded[["PRIORITARIO"]]), " for income after removing missing characteristics. ",
  "Column (1) uses the complier-profile estimator described in Appendix~\\ref{app:ninth-grade-composition}; ",
  "heteroskedasticity-robust influence-function SE are in parentheses. Its $N$ is the estimation sample size, ",
  "not a count of identified compliers. Columns (2) and (3) are student-weighted means. ",
  "GPA is on the composition analysis's national prior-year scale; the lottery measure is converted using exact ",
  "year-specific affine relationships in linked records. Low-income status is measured in the application year ",
  "for applicants and compliers, and the entry year for entrants. ",
  "These profiles describe different populations and do not identify the students whose access changed under SAE.")
text_claims("the note of Appendix Table B.6: the supported entering classes are 2017-2019" =
            identical(as.integer(range(support_region_year$ENTRY_YEAR)), c(2017L, 2019L)))
write_tex(b_float("Entrants and Lottery Compliers in the Supported Ninth-Grade Cohorts",
                  "tab: ninth grade profiles", "p{0.30\\textwidth}ccc", profile_body, profile_note),
          "appendix_ninth_grade_profiles.tex")
rm(linked_profiles, od_choices)
```

## Appendix Table B.7: entrant counts by low-income status

Splits the entrants of each cell-year into the low-income entrants and the others (the entry-year
roster, known for every entrant) and estimates SAE's effect on the three counts and on the low-income
share. Panel A: did's estimates, each fit with 10,000 bootstrap draws from the seed `SEED_COUNTS`, so
the four fits share their region multipliers and the counts add up draw by draw (both checked on the
saved bootstrap draws of the overall effects). Panel B: the paired estimates the randomization test
uses, their delete-one-region jackknife SEs and their randomization p-values, over the 2,999 saved
reassignments `intake_count` for the counts and Table II's 9,999 for the share (the total and the
share are Appendix Table B.4's and Table II's tests). Writes `tables/appendix_entrant_counts.tex`,
`tables/entrant_count_macros.tex` and, at full precision, `numbers/entrant_counts.csv` (Panels A and
B, with each p-value's count and total).

```{r entrant-count-table}
counts_by_cell <- EP[, .(n_low = sum(PRIO == 1L), n_other = sum(PRIO == 0L)), by = .(rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL, yr = AGNO)]
CC <- CP[, .(cell, cell_id, rbd, cod_nivel, yr, region, is_entry, door, G, n_ent, sh_prio)]
CC[counts_by_cell, on = .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr), `:=`(n_low = i.n_low, n_other = i.n_other)]
stopifnot("the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: the low-income flag is 0 or 1 for every entrant" =
            !anyNA(EP$PRIO) && all(EP$PRIO %in% 0:1),
          "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: every cell-year's entrants split into the two counts" =
            !anyNA(CC$n_low) && all(CC$n_ent == CC$n_low + CC$n_other),
          "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: every cell-year has an entrant" = all(CC$n_ent > 0L))
count_outcomes <- c("n_ent", "n_low", "n_other", "sh_prio")
count_labels <- c("Total entrants", "Low-income entrants", "Other entrants", "Low-income share (pp)")
# the four fits, in the table's order, each from the seed SEED_COUNTS
count_fits <- setNames(lapply(count_outcomes, function(count_y) {
  d <- as.data.frame(CC[, .(cell_id, yr, G, region, y = get(count_y))])
  set.seed(SEED_COUNTS)
  value <- fit_did_aggs(d, paste0("entrant_counts_", count_y), list(list(type = "simple", na.rm = TRUE, cband = FALSE)))
  fit <- value$fit; agg <- value$aggregates[[1L]]
  support <- check_post_effects(fit, agg$overall.att, CC, count_y, 1e-9)
  scale <- if (count_y == "sh_prio") 100 else 1
  list(att = agg$overall.att, weights = support$weight, gt = support$estimate, entering_classes = range(support$t),
       row = data.table(outcome = count_y, label = count_labels[match(count_y, count_outcomes)],
         pre_mean = scale * pre_mean(CC, count_y), estimate = scale * agg$overall.att, se = scale * agg$overall.se,
         lower = scale * (agg$overall.att - qnorm(.975) * agg$overall.se),
         upper = scale * (agg$overall.att + qnorm(.975) * agg$overall.se),
         cells = uniqueN(fit$DIDparams$data$cell_id), cell_years = nrow(fit$DIDparams$data)))
}), count_outcomes)
count_results <- rbindlist(lapply(count_fits, `[[`, "row"))
stopifnot("the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: the counts add up, group-time effect by group-time effect and overall" =
            max(abs(count_fits$n_ent$gt - count_fits$n_low$gt - count_fits$n_other$gt)) < 1e-8 &&
            abs(count_fits$n_ent$att - count_fits$n_low$att - count_fits$n_other$att) < 1e-8,
          "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: the four outcomes share their aggregation weights" =
            identical(count_fits$n_ent$weights, count_fits$n_low$weights) && identical(count_fits$n_ent$weights, count_fits$n_other$weights) &&
            identical(count_fits$n_ent$weights, count_fits$sh_prio$weights),
          "finite SEs" = all(is.finite(count_results$se)),
          "the total and the share: Appendix Table B.4's and Table II's point estimates" =
            abs(count_fits$n_ent$att - g_ent$att) < 1e-12 && abs(count_fits$sh_prio$att - p_reg$att) < 1e-12)
# the note's statement about the entering classes
text_claims("the note of Appendix Table B.7: each fit covers the entering classes of 2017-2020" =
              all(vapply(count_fits, function(f) identical(as.integer(f$entering_classes), c(2017L, 2020L)), TRUE)))
# the counts add up draw by draw: each fit's saved bootstrap draws of its overall effect (its second bootstrap, the simple
# aggregation's) hold the same region multipliers, and the total's deviations are the low-income and other counts' summed
count_draws <- lapply(count_outcomes, function(count_y) readRDS(file.path(BOOT_DIR, sprintf("entrant_counts_%s_02.rds", count_y))))
stopifnot("the saved draws: each fit's simple aggregation, B_BOOT draws of one deviation" =
            all(vapply(seq_along(count_outcomes), function(j) {
              z <- count_draws[[j]]
              identical(z$id, paste0("entrant_counts_", count_outcomes[j])) && z$call == 2L && z$biters == B_BOOT &&
                identical(dim(z$deviations), c(as.integer(B_BOOT), 1L))
            }, TRUE)),
          "the four fits draw the same region multipliers" =
            all(vapply(count_draws, function(z) identical(z$multipliers, count_draws[[1L]]$multipliers), TRUE)),
          "the counts add up draw by draw: total = low-income + other" =
            max(abs(count_draws[[1L]]$deviations - count_draws[[2L]]$deviations - count_draws[[3L]]$deviations)) < 1e-8)
rm(count_draws)

# Panel B: the low-income and other counts tested over the 2,999 reassignments `intake_count`; the total is Appendix Table B.4's
# test and the share Table II's
cl <- if (main_workers > 1L) makeCluster(main_workers) else NULL
if (!is.null(cl)) {
  clusterEvalQ(cl, { data.table::setDTthreads(1L); NULL })
  clusterExport(cl, names(worker_code), envir = list2env(worker_code))
}
z_low <- score_stream(prep_ri(CC, "n_low"), wave_map(CC), B_RI_ROBUST, key = "intake_count")
z_other <- score_stream(prep_ri(CC, "n_other"), wave_map(CC), B_RI_ROBUST, key = "intake_count")
if (!is.null(cl)) stopCluster(cl)
paired <- data.table(outcome = count_outcomes,
  paired_estimate = c(z_ent$th, z_low$th, z_other$th, 100 * unname(obs_p["th"])),
  paired_jackknife_se = c(z_ent$th / z_ent$t, z_low$th / z_low$t, z_other$th / z_other$t, 100 * unname(obs_p["th"] / obs_p["t"])),
  p_ri = c(z_ent$p, z_low$p, z_other$p, p_p),
  ri_count = c(z_ent$count, z_low$count, z_other$count, p_p_count), ri_total = c(z_ent$total, z_low$total, z_other$total, 1 + B_RI))
stopifnot("each p is its count over its total, as p_count reads it" = identical(paired$p_ri, paired$ri_count / paired$ri_total))
count_results <- merge(count_results, paired, by = "outcome", sort = FALSE)[match(count_outcomes, outcome)]
print(count_results)
fwrite(count_results, file.path(NUM_DIR, "entrant_counts.csv"))

f2 <- function(x) no_minus_zero(sprintf("%.2f", x))   # never "-0.00"
count_macros <- c(CountLowATT = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_low", estimate]),
                  CountLowLower = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_low", lower]), CountLowUpper = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_low", upper]),
                  CountOtherATT = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_other", estimate]),
                  CountOtherAbsATT = f2(abs(count_results[outcome == "n_other", estimate])),
                  CountOtherLower = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_other", lower]), CountOtherUpper = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_other", upper]),
                  CountTotalATT = f2(count_results[outcome == "n_ent", estimate]),
                  CountTotalAbsATT = f2(abs(count_results[outcome == "n_ent", estimate])))
write_tex(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\%s}{%s}", names(count_macros), count_macros), "entrant_count_macros.tex")
panel_a_rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(count_results)), function(i) {
  r <- count_results[i]
  paste0(r$label, " & ", f2(r$pre_mean), " & $", f2(r$estimate), "$ & ", f2(r$se), " & $[", f2(r$lower), ", ", f2(r$upper), "]$ \\\\")
}, character(1))
panel_b_rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(count_results)), function(i) {
  r <- count_results[i]
  pv <- if (r$p_ri < .001) "$<0.001$" else p_count(r$ri_count, r$ri_total, 3L)
  paste0(r$label, " & & $", f2(r$paired_estimate), "$ & ", f2(r$paired_jackknife_se), " & ", pv, " \\\\")
}, character(1))
# the note's entering classes, from the four fits' post-adoption effects (one span for all four)
count_span <- unique(vapply(count_fits, function(f) year_span(f$entering_classes), ""))
stopifnot("the four fits cover the same entering classes" = length(count_span) == 1L)
count_note <- paste0("Notes: Counts are entrants per school-grade-year; shares are in percentage points. ",
  "Low-income status is the entry-year \\emph{prioritario} flag; other entrants are those not flagged. ",
  "Panel A uses the common positive-entry sample and adoption-group weights of the main composition design (",
  comma_int(count_results$cells[1]), " school-grades and ", comma_int(count_results$cell_years[1]), " cell-years). ",
  "Unobserved school-grade-years are not assigned zero entrants. Pre-adoption means average observed cell-years before adoption. ",
  "The group-time estimates use not-yet-treated comparisons and a universal $g-1$ base, ",
  "covering supported entering classes in ", count_span, ". Panel A SE use ", comma_int(B_BOOT), " region-clustered multiplier-bootstrap draws; ",
  "intervals are pointwise normal intervals using those SE. Panel B restricts each comparison to cells observed in both years ",
  "and weights contrasts by their paired treated-cell counts. It reports delete-one-region jackknife SE and ",
  "studentized permutation tests using ", comma_int(B_RI_ROBUST), " regional reassignments for counts and ", comma_int(B_RI), " for the share. ",
  "These tests concern Panel B estimates; see Appendix~\\ref{app: regional inference}. ",
  "Neither procedure resolves the few-region inference concerns. The estimates do not measure subgroup admission probabilities or national entrant totals.")
write_tex(c("\\begin{table}[!htbp]", "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
            "\\centering", "\\caption{Entrant Counts and Low-Income Composition}",
            "\\label{tab: entrant counts}", "\\small", "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{4pt}",
            "\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}lrrrr@{}}", "\\toprule",
            "\\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel A. Unbalanced-panel estimates}} \\\\[3pt]",
            "Outcome & \\makecell{Pre-adoption\\\\mean} & Effect & SE & 95\\% CI \\\\",
            "\\midrule", panel_a_rows, "\\addlinespace[9pt]",
            "\\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel B. Paired estimates and regional permutation tests}} \\\\[3pt]",
            "Outcome & & Effect & \\makecell{Jackknife\\\\SE} & \\makecell{Permutation\\\\$p$-value} \\\\",
            "\\midrule", panel_b_rows, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular*}", "\\par\\smallskip",
            "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize", count_note, "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}"),
          "appendix_entrant_counts.tex")
```

## Appendix Table B.3, last row: the sample of prior grades earned before SAE coverage

Builds the restricted cell-year panel of Appendix Table B.3's last row: the entrants to grades 2-12
with a prior-year GPA whose prior-year grades were all earned before SAE reached the region and grade
of her prior-year records (`ELIGIBLE_HISTORY`). Checks first that summing every entrant reproduces
the cell-year panel. Also builds the pieces the randomization test needs to recompute the restricted
outcomes under each reassigned rollout (each cell-year's entrants grouped by the regions and
entry-grade status of their prior records). Everything stays in memory.

```{r prior-gpa-sample}
years <- 2012L:2023L
started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
assert_columns <- function(d, required, label) {
  absent <- setdiff(required, names(d))
  if (length(absent)) stop(label, " missing fields: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}

# the inputs: the composition panel and the cell-year panel summed from it above
cell_year_panel <- copy(OUT)
panel_keys <- c("rbd", "cod_nivel", "yr")
cell_columns <- c("rbd", "cod_nivel", "region", "is_entry", "door",
                  "slack_fail", "door_year_tag")
assert_columns(cell_year_panel, c(cell_columns, "yr", "n_ent", "n_gpa", "gpa_z", "sh_prio"),
               "the cell-year panel")
if (anyDuplicated(cell_year_panel, by = panel_keys)) stop("the cell-year panel has duplicate cell-years")
cells_all <- unique(cell_year_panel[, ..cell_columns])
if (anyDuplicated(cells_all, by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))) {
  stop("a cell's fields vary across years")
}
if (nrow(cells_all) != N_CELLS) stop("the cell-year panel does not hold the panel's ", format(N_CELLS, big.mark = ","), " school-grades")
child_fields <- c("PRIOR_GPA_Z", "N_PRIOR_RECORDS", "UNKNOWN_SCHOOL", "UNKNOWN_REGION", "UNKNOWN_GRADE",
                  "UNKNOWN_CALENDAR", "EXPOSURE_KNOWN", "EXPOSED", "SIGNATURE", "ELIGIBLE_HISTORY")
assert_columns(EP, c("MRUN", "AGNO", "RBD", "COD_NIVEL", "PRIO", child_fields), "the composition panel")

# each region's wave: the door of its entry grades, one year earlier than the door of its other grades
wave_rows <- unique(cells_all[, .(region, wave = door - (1L - is_entry))])[order(region)]
if (anyDuplicated(wave_rows$region)) stop("a region has more than one wave")
if (nrow(wave_rows) != 16L) stop("the rollout must cover the 16 regions")
region_waves <- setNames(as.integer(wave_rows$wave), as.character(wave_rows$region))

cells <- copy(cells_all[cod_nivel >= 2L & cod_nivel <= 12L])
setorder(cells, rbd, cod_nivel)
cells[, cell_id := .I]
cell_years <- merge(cell_year_panel[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr)],
                    cells[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, cell_id)], by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
setorder(cell_years, cell_id, yr)
cell_years[, cell_year_id := .I]
cell_years <- cell_years[, .(cell_year_id, cell_id, yr)]

say("Entrants and their prior-year record fields, from the composition panel")
per_year <- function() setNames(vector("list", length(years)), as.character(years))
rebuilt_years <- per_year(); restricted_years <- per_year(); component_years <- per_year()
group_years <- per_year()

for (yr_value in years) {
  key <- as.character(yr_value)
  census_data <- EP[AGNO == yr_value, .(mrun = as.character(MRUN), rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL)]
  prio_set <- EP[AGNO == yr_value & PRIO == 1L, as.character(MRUN)]
  children <- EP[AGNO == yr_value & !is.na(N_PRIOR_RECORDS), .(
    mrun = as.character(MRUN), z = PRIOR_GPA_Z, n_prior_records = N_PRIOR_RECORDS, unknown_school = UNKNOWN_SCHOOL,
    unknown_region = UNKNOWN_REGION, unknown_grade = UNKNOWN_GRADE, unknown_calendar = UNKNOWN_CALENDAR,
    exposure_known = EXPOSURE_KNOWN, exposed = EXPOSED, signature = SIGNATURE, eligible_history = ELIGIBLE_HISTORY)]
  entrants <- merge(census_data, cells_all, by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
  if (nrow(entrants) != nrow(census_data)) stop("every entrant's cell must be one of the panel's cells")
  entrants[, `:=`(yr = yr_value, prio = as.integer(mrun %chin% prio_set))]
  n_entrants <- nrow(entrants)
  entrants <- merge(entrants, children, by = "mrun", all.x = TRUE)
  if (nrow(entrants) != n_entrants) stop("the prior-record join must keep one row per entrant")
  if (anyDuplicated(entrants, by = c("mrun", "rbd", "cod_nivel"))) {
    stop("an entrant appears twice in one cell and year")
  }
  entrants[, `:=`(
    valid_prior_gpa = !is.na(z),
    receiving_grade_eligible = cod_nivel >= 2L & cod_nivel <= 12L
  )]
  entrants[, eligible := receiving_grade_eligible & valid_prior_gpa &
                           !is.na(eligible_history) & eligible_history]
  rebuilt_years[[key]] <- entrants[, .(
    n_ent = .N, n_gpa = sum(!is.na(z)),
    gpa_z = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), sh_prio = mean(prio)
  ), by = c(cell_columns, "yr")]
  restricted_years[[key]] <- entrants[eligible == TRUE, .(
    n_ent = .N, n_gpa = .N, gpa_z = mean(z), sh_prio = mean(prio)
  ), by = c(cell_columns, "yr")]
  comp <- entrants[receiving_grade_eligible & valid_prior_gpa & exposure_known, .(
    n = .N, sum_z = sum(z), sum_prio = sum(prio)
  ), by = .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr, signature)]
  comp <- merge(comp, cells[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, cell_id)], by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
  comp <- merge(comp, cell_years, by = c("cell_id", "yr"))
  component_years[[key]] <- comp[, .(
    cell_year_id, signature, n, sum_z, sum_prio
  )]
  group_years[[key]] <- entrants[, .(
    all_entrants = .N, valid_prior_gpa = sum(valid_prior_gpa),
    known_exposure = sum(exposure_known %in% TRUE), retained = sum(eligible),
    multiple_gpa_records = sum(n_prior_records > 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    unknown_school = sum(unknown_school %in% TRUE),
    unknown_region = sum(unknown_region %in% TRUE),
    unknown_grade = sum(unknown_grade %in% TRUE),
    unknown_calendar = sum(unknown_calendar %in% TRUE)
  ), by = .(yr, cod_nivel, door, region)]
  say("Year %d | entrants %s | retained %s | %.1f min", yr_value, format(nrow(entrants), big.mark = ","),
      format(entrants[eligible == TRUE, .N], big.mark = ","), (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started) / 60)
  rm(census_data, prio_set, children, entrants, comp)
  invisible(gc())
}

# every entrant summed by cell-year reproduces the cell-year panel
rebuilt <- rbindlist(rebuilt_years)
rebuilt[cod_nivel == 1L, `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]
rebuilt[cod_nivel %in% c(-1L, 0L), `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]   # as the chunk inputs blanks them
setcolorder(rebuilt, names(cell_year_panel))
setorderv(rebuilt, panel_keys)
setorderv(cell_year_panel, panel_keys)
same_keys <- identical(as.data.frame(rebuilt[, ..panel_keys]),
                       as.data.frame(cell_year_panel[, ..panel_keys]))
value_checks <- if (!same_keys) list() else lapply(setdiff(names(cell_year_panel), panel_keys), function(v) {
  x <- rebuilt[[v]]
  y <- cell_year_panel[[v]]
  same_missing <- identical(is.na(x), is.na(y))
  finite_both <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  max_difference <- if (any(finite_both)) max(abs(x[finite_both] - y[finite_both])) else 0
  tolerance <- if (v %in% c("gpa_z", "sh_prio")) 1e-10 else 0
  data.table(check = paste0("same_", v),
             passed = same_missing && is.finite(max_difference) && max_difference <= tolerance,
             max_difference = max_difference)
})
reconciliation <- rbindlist(c(list(data.table(check = "same_cell_year_keys", passed = same_keys, max_difference = NA_real_)),
                              value_checks))
print(reconciliation)
if (!all(reconciliation$passed)) stop("the entrants summed by cell-year differ from the cell-year panel; see the table above")

restricted <- rbindlist(restricted_years)
setcolorder(restricted, names(cell_year_panel))
setorderv(restricted, panel_keys)
components <- rbindlist(component_years)
signature_keys <- data.table(signature = sort(unique(components$signature), method = "radix"))
signature_keys[, signature_id := .I]
components <- merge(components, signature_keys, by = "signature")
components <- components[, .(cell_year_id, signature_id, n, sum_z, sum_prio)]
setorder(components, cell_year_id, signature_id)
signatures <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(signature_keys)), function(i) {
  parts <- strsplit(signature_keys$signature[[i]], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  parsed <- tstrsplit(parts, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  data.table(signature_id = i, sending_region = as.integer(parsed[[1L]]),
             is_entry = as.integer(parsed[[2L]]))
}))
exposure_components <- list(
  cells = cells, cell_years = cell_years, signatures = signatures,
  components = components, waves = region_waves
)
group_counts <- rbindlist(group_years)
stopifnot("the restricted sample keeps some entrants and leaves some out" =
            sum(group_counts$retained) > 0L && sum(group_counts$retained) < sum(group_counts$all_entrants))
say("Restricted sample: %s entrant child-years in %s cell-years; the entrants summed reproduce the cell-year panel",
    format(sum(restricted$n_ent), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(restricted), big.mark = ","))
rm(EP, OUT, cell_year_panel)
invisible(gc())
```

## Appendix Table B.3, last row: the estimators of the restricted sample

Defines did's estimate on the restricted panel and the randomization statistic, which rebuilds the
restricted outcomes under each reassigned rollout (an entrant's prior-year grades count as earned
before SAE coverage when, under that rollout, SAE reached every region and grade group of her
prior-year records after the year she earned them).

```{r prior-gpa-functions}
# did's overall effect on the restricted panel, with n_boot bootstrap draws; returns the estimate, SE,
# counts, the pre-adoption mean, the data, the fit and its aggregation
estimate_cs <- function(data, outcome, n_boot) {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(data), outcome %in% c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"),
            is.integer(n_boot), n_boot > 0L)
  d <- data[!is.na(get(outcome)), .(cell_id, yr, G, region, y = get(outcome))]
  stopifnot(nrow(d) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(d[, .(cell_id, yr)]),
            all(is.finite(d$y)), !anyNA(d))
  estimate <- fit_did(d, paste0("prior_gpa_", outcome), bit = n_boot, keep_fit = TRUE)
  fit <- estimate$fit
  aggregate <- estimate$aggregate
  stopifnot(is.finite(aggregate$overall.att), is.finite(aggregate$overall.se))
  list(estimate = aggregate$overall.att, se = aggregate$overall.se,
       n_obs = nrow(d), n_cells = uniqueN(d$cell_id), n_regions = uniqueN(d$region),
       pre_mean = d[yr < G, mean(y)], input = d, fit = fit, aggregate = aggregate)
}

# the pieces the rebuild under a rollout needs, checked: cells, cell-years, the signatures (regions
# and entry-grade status of the prior records) and each cell-year's entrants grouped by signature
prepare_exposure_context <- function(data) {
  required <- c("cells", "cell_years", "signatures", "components")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(data)))
  cells <- as.data.table(copy(data$cells))[order(cell_id)]
  years <- as.data.table(copy(data$cell_years))[order(cell_year_id)]
  signatures <- as.data.table(copy(data$signatures))
  components <- as.data.table(copy(data$components))
  stopifnot(identical(cells$cell_id, seq_len(nrow(cells))),
            identical(years$cell_year_id, seq_len(nrow(years))),
            !anyDuplicated(years[, .(cell_id, yr)]),
            !anyNA(signatures[, .(signature_id, sending_region, is_entry)]),
            all(components$n > 0L),
            all(is.finite(components$sum_z)), all(is.finite(components$sum_prio)))
  regions <- sort(unique(cells$region))
  stopifnot(length(regions) == 16L,
            all(signatures$sending_region %in% regions),
            all(signatures$is_entry %in% c(0L, 1L)))
  waves_dt <- unique(cells[, .(region, wave = door - (1L - is_entry))])
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(waves_dt$region))
  stopifnot(all(waves_dt$wave %in% 2016L:2019L))
  waves <- setNames(as.integer(waves_dt$wave[match(regions, waves_dt$region)]), as.character(regions))
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(sort(as.vector(table(waves)))), c(1L, 1L, 4L, 10L)))
  n_signatures <- max(signatures$signature_id)
  stopifnot(identical(sort(unique(signatures$signature_id)), seq_len(n_signatures)),
            all(components$signature_id %in% signatures$signature_id),
            all(components$cell_year_id %in% years$cell_year_id))
  yr_values <- sort(unique(years$yr))
  matrix_index <- years$cell_id + (match(years$yr, yr_values) - 1L) * nrow(cells)
  sig_members <- split(seq_len(nrow(signatures)), signatures$signature_id)
  signature_columns <- lapply(seq_len(max(lengths(sig_members))), function(j)
    vapply(sig_members, function(ix) ix[min(j, length(ix))], integer(1L)))
  list(cells = cells, cell_years = years, components = components,
       signature_region_index = match(signatures$sending_region, regions),
       signature_offset = as.integer(2L - signatures$is_entry),
       signature_columns = signature_columns,
       component_year = years$yr[components$cell_year_id],
       component_values = as.matrix(components[, .(n, sum_z, sum_prio)]),
       n_signatures = n_signatures, waves = waves, regions = regions,
       region_index = match(cells$region, regions), years = yr_values,
       matrix_index = matrix_index)
}

# the restricted outcomes under a rollout `waves`: a group of entrants counts when its cell-year comes
# no later than the first academic year SAE covered any of its sending regions and grades; returns the
# GPA and low-income matrices (cell x year) and each cell-year's count
rebuild_exposure_outcomes <- function(context, waves) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(waves), as.character(context$regions)), !anyNA(waves))
  member_first <- unname(waves)[context$signature_region_index] + context$signature_offset
  first_academic <- do.call(pmin, lapply(context$signature_columns, function(ix) member_first[ix]))
  eligible <- context$component_year <= first_academic[context$components$signature_id]
  totals <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(context$cell_years), ncol = 3L)
  if (any(eligible)) {
    sums <- rowsum(context$component_values[eligible, , drop = FALSE],
                   context$components$cell_year_id[eligible], reorder = FALSE)
    totals[as.integer(rownames(sums)), ] <- sums
  }
  n <- totals[, 1L]
  gpa <- prio <- rep(NA_real_, length(n))
  observed <- n > 0L
  gpa[observed] <- totals[observed, 2L] / n[observed]
  prio[observed] <- totals[observed, 3L] / n[observed]
  M_gpa <- M_prio <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(context$cells), ncol = length(context$years))
  M_gpa[context$matrix_index] <- gpa
  M_prio[context$matrix_index] <- prio
  list(gpa_z = M_gpa, sh_prio = M_prio, n_eligible = n)
}

# the paired estimate written out group by group (the reference the fast version is checked against)
simple_att_literal <- function(data, adoption, years) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(data), nrow(data) == length(adoption))
  numerator <- 0
  denominator <- 0
  for (g in sort(unique(adoption))) {
    baseline <- match(g - 1L, years)
    if (is.na(baseline)) next
    treated <- adoption == g
    for (t in years[years >= g]) {
      current <- match(t, years)
      ok_t <- treated & !is.na(data[, current]) & !is.na(data[, baseline])
      ok_c <- adoption > t & !is.na(data[, current]) & !is.na(data[, baseline])
      if (!any(ok_t) || !any(ok_c)) next
      att <- mean(data[ok_t, current] - data[ok_t, baseline]) -
        mean(data[ok_c, current] - data[ok_c, baseline])
      weight <- sum(ok_t)
      numerator <- numerator + weight * att
      denominator <- denominator + weight
    }
  }
  if (denominator <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  numerator / denominator
}

# the paired estimate, its studentized statistic and the delete-one-region estimates, written out
jackknife_literal <- function(data, adoption, years, region, regions) {
  att <- simple_att_literal(data, adoption, years)
  loo <- vapply(regions, function(r) {
    keep <- region != r
    simple_att_literal(data[keep, , drop = FALSE], adoption[keep], years)
  }, numeric(1L))
  ok <- !is.na(loo)
  n_valid <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (n_valid >= 2L) {
    (n_valid - 1L) / n_valid * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2)
  } else NA_real_
  c(att = att, statistic = att / sqrt(variance), jk_se = sqrt(variance),
    n_valid_loo = n_valid, setNames(loo, paste0("loo_", regions)))
}

# the same as jackknife_literal, computed with region sums (every delete-one-region estimate in one pass)
jackknife_fast <- function(data, adoption, years, region_index, regions) {
  n_regions <- length(regions)
  numerator <- denominator <- numeric(n_regions + 1L)
  for (g in sort(unique(adoption))) {
    baseline <- match(g - 1L, years)
    if (is.na(baseline)) next
    for (t in years[years >= g]) {
      current <- match(t, years)
      difference <- data[, current] - data[, baseline]
      ok <- !is.na(difference)
      treated <- ok & adoption == g
      control <- ok & adoption > t
      if (!any(treated) || !any(control)) next
      counts_t <- tabulate(region_index[treated], nbins = n_regions)
      counts_c <- tabulate(region_index[control], nbins = n_regions)
      sums <- matrix(0, nrow = n_regions, ncol = 2L)
      st <- rowsum(difference[treated], region_index[treated], reorder = FALSE)
      sc <- rowsum(difference[control], region_index[control], reorder = FALSE)
      sums[as.integer(rownames(st)), 1L] <- st[, 1L]
      sums[as.integer(rownames(sc)), 2L] <- sc[, 1L]
      nt <- sum(counts_t) - c(0L, counts_t)
      nc <- sum(counts_c) - c(0L, counts_c)
      sum_t <- sum(sums[, 1L]) - c(0, sums[, 1L])
      sum_c <- sum(sums[, 2L]) - c(0, sums[, 2L])
      valid <- nt > 0L & nc > 0L
      numerator[valid] <- numerator[valid] + sum_t[valid] - nt[valid] * sum_c[valid] / nc[valid]
      denominator[valid] <- denominator[valid] + nt[valid]
    }
  }
  estimates <- rep(NA_real_, n_regions + 1L)
  estimates[denominator > 0] <- numerator[denominator > 0] / denominator[denominator > 0]
  att <- estimates[1L]
  loo <- estimates[-1L]
  ok <- !is.na(loo)
  n_valid <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (n_valid >= 2L) {
    (n_valid - 1L) / n_valid * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2)
  } else NA_real_
  c(att = att, statistic = att / sqrt(variance), jk_se = sqrt(variance),
    n_valid_loo = n_valid, setNames(loo, paste0("loo_", regions)))
}

# both restricted outcomes' statistics under one rollout
score_exposure_map <- function(waves, context) {
  outcomes <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, waves)
  adoption <- unname(waves)[context$region_index] + 2L - context$cells$is_entry
  result <- lapply(c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"), function(outcome) {
    value <- jackknife_fast(outcomes[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                            context$region_index, context$regions)
    setNames(value, paste0(outcome, "__", names(value)))
  })
  unlist(result, use.names = TRUE)
}
```

## Appendix Table B.3, last row: did estimates

Fits did on the restricted panel for both outcomes, with 10,000 bootstrap draws each.

```{r prior-gpa-effects}
# The results of this row carry its label in their first column
SPEC_ID <- "prior-grade restriction"
OUTCOMES <- c("gpa_z", "sh_prio")
set.seed(SEED_PRIOR)
restricted_data <- copy(restricted)
restricted_data[, cell := paste(rbd, cod_nivel, sep = "|")]
restricted_data[, cell_id := as.integer(factor(cell))]
restricted_data[, G := as.integer(door + 1L)]
stopifnot("every restricted cell-year with a GPA mean counts all its entrants" =
            all(restricted_data[!is.na(gpa_z), n_ent] == restricted_data[!is.na(gpa_z), n_gpa]),
          "both outcomes are present in the same cell-years" =
            identical(is.na(restricted_data$gpa_z), is.na(restricted_data$sh_prio)))
fits <- setNames(vector("list", length(OUTCOMES)), OUTCOMES)
for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
  say("Fitting %s with %d bootstrap draws", outcome, as.integer(B_BOOT))
  fits[[outcome]] <- estimate_cs(restricted_data, outcome, as.integer(B_BOOT))   # did receives an integer count here
}
fit_bundle <- list(spec_id = SPEC_ID, seed = SEED_PRIOR, n_boot = as.integer(B_BOOT), fits = fits)
stopCluster(model_worker)
```

## Appendix Table B.3, last row: randomization test

Checks that the restricted outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel, and
that the fast statistic equals the literal one under five rollouts; then scores the 9,999 saved
reassignments `prior_gpa`.

```{r prior-gpa-permutations}
data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
context <- prepare_exposure_context(exposure_components)
observed_outcomes <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, context$waves)
restricted_check <- copy(restricted)
restricted_check <- merge(restricted_check, context$cells[, .(cell_id, rbd, cod_nivel)],
                          by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(restricted_check$cell_id), !anyDuplicated(restricted_check[, .(cell_id, yr)]))
index <- restricted_check$cell_id + (match(restricted_check$yr, context$years) - 1L) * nrow(context$cells)
year_keys <- paste(context$cell_years$cell_id, context$cell_years$yr, sep = "|")
panel_year_keys <- paste(restricted_check$cell_id, restricted_check$yr, sep = "|")
year_match <- match(panel_year_keys, year_keys)
stopifnot(!anyNA(year_match),
          identical(is.na(restricted_check$gpa_z), is.na(restricted_check$sh_prio)),
          "the entrant counts rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel's" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(restricted_check$n_ent), observed_outcomes$n_eligible[year_match],
                             tolerance = 1e-12, check.attributes = FALSE)),
          "no eligible cell-year lies outside the restricted panel" =
            !any(observed_outcomes$n_eligible[!year_keys %in% panel_year_keys] > 0L))
for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
  stopifnot("the outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel's" =
              isTRUE(all.equal(restricted_check[[outcome]], observed_outcomes[[outcome]][index],
                               tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE)),
            "the same number of cell-years with the outcome" =
              sum(!is.na(observed_outcomes[[outcome]])) == sum(!is.na(restricted_check[[outcome]])))
}
waves_matrix <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = B_RI, ncol = length(context$regions),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(context$regions)))
saved_waves <- wave_draws("prior_gpa", context$waves, B_RI)
for (draw in seq_len(B_RI)) waves_matrix[draw, ] <- saved_waves[[draw]]
check_maps <- c(list(context$waves), lapply(c(1L, 2L, 17L, 100L),
                  function(i) setNames(waves_matrix[i, ], colnames(waves_matrix))))
equivalence_checks <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(check_maps), function(map_id) {
  check_waves <- check_maps[[map_id]]
  check_rebuilt <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, check_waves)
  adoption <- unname(check_waves)[context$region_index] + 2L - context$cells$is_entry
  rbindlist(lapply(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
    fast <- jackknife_fast(check_rebuilt[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                           context$region_index, context$regions)
    literal <- jackknife_literal(check_rebuilt[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                                 context$cells$region, context$regions)
    stopifnot("the fast statistic equals the literal one" =
                isTRUE(all.equal(fast, literal, tolerance = 1e-9)))
    data.table(map_id = map_id, outcome = outcome,
               max_abs_difference = max(abs(fast - literal), na.rm = TRUE),
               n_valid_loo = fast[["n_valid_loo"]])
  }))
}))
print(equivalence_checks)
observed <- score_exposure_map(context$waves, context)
stopifnot("the observed randomization statistics are defined" = all(is.finite(observed)))
say("The restricted outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel; the fast and literal statistics agree under five rollouts.")

results <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B_RI, ncol = length(observed),
                  dimnames = list(NULL, names(observed)))
N_WORKERS <- worker_limit(rep(512 * 1024^2 + 4 * as.numeric(object.size(context)), N_CORES), N_CORES,
                          "randomization test of Appendix Table B.3's last row")
cluster <- if (N_WORKERS > 1L) parallel::makeCluster(N_WORKERS) else NULL
worker_code <- list(context = context, rebuild_exposure_outcomes = rebuild_exposure_outcomes,
                    jackknife_fast = jackknife_fast, score_exposure_map = score_exposure_map)
for (name in c("rebuild_exposure_outcomes", "jackknife_fast", "score_exposure_map"))
  environment(worker_code[[name]]) <- .GlobalEnv
if (!is.null(cluster))
  parallel::clusterExport(cluster, names(worker_code), envir = list2env(worker_code))
score_map <- function(waves) score_exposure_map(waves, context)
environment(score_map) <- .GlobalEnv
tryCatch({
  if (!is.null(cluster))
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cluster, { data.table::setDTthreads(1L); NULL })
  batch_size <- max(256L, 16L * N_WORKERS)
  for (start in seq.int(1L, B_RI, by = batch_size)) {
    ids <- seq.int(start, min(B_RI, start + batch_size - 1L))
    maps <- lapply(ids, function(i) setNames(waves_matrix[i, ], colnames(waves_matrix)))
    scored <- if (is.null(cluster)) lapply(maps, function(w) score_exposure_map(w, context)) else
      parallel::parLapplyLB(cluster, maps, score_map,
        chunk.size = max(1L, ceiling(length(maps) / (4L * N_WORKERS))))
    results[ids, ] <- do.call(rbind, scored)
    say("Scored %d / %d reassignments.", max(ids), B_RI)
  }
}, finally = if (!is.null(cluster)) parallel::stopCluster(cluster))
randomization <- list(spec_id = SPEC_ID, seed = SEED_PRIOR, n_perm = B_RI,
                      completed = B_RI, observed = observed, results = results,
                      assignments = waves_matrix, checks = equivalence_checks)
invalid <- which(!apply(is.finite(results), 1L, all))
stopifnot("every reassignment's statistic is defined (stars need all 9,999)" = length(invalid) == 0L)
```

## Appendix Table B.3, last row: results

Combines the did fits and the randomization test into the row's estimate, SE and randomization p.
Writes `numbers/restricted_results.csv`.

```{r prior-gpa-results}
analysis_panel <- copy(restricted_data)   # the restricted panel the two fits read
stopifnot(identical(fit_bundle$spec_id, SPEC_ID), identical(randomization$spec_id, SPEC_ID),
          identical(randomization$completed, B_RI), nrow(randomization$results) == B_RI,
          all(is.finite(randomization$results)), all(is.finite(randomization$observed)),
          !any(vapply(fit_bundle$fits, is.null, logical(1L))))
rows <- lapply(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
  fit <- fit_bundle$fits[[outcome]]
  test_name <- paste0(outcome, "__statistic")
  paired_name <- paste0(outcome, "__att")
  ri_p <- (1L + sum(abs(randomization$results[, test_name]) >=
                      abs(randomization$observed[[test_name]]))) / (1L + B_RI)
  stars <- if (ri_p < .01) "***" else if (ri_p < .05) "**" else if (ri_p < .10) "*" else ""
  d <- analysis_panel[!is.na(get(outcome))]
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == fit$n_obs,
            isTRUE(all.equal(d[yr < G, mean(get(outcome))], fit$pre_mean, tolerance = 1e-12)))
  data.table(spec_id = SPEC_ID, outcome = outcome, att = fit$estimate, se = fit$se,
             ri_p = ri_p, stars = stars, pre_mean = fit$pre_mean, n_obs = fit$n_obs,
             n_cells = fit$n_cells, n_regions = fit$n_regions,
             eligible_entrant_records = sum(d$n_ent),
             observed_paired_att = randomization$observed[[paired_name]],
             paired_minus_did = randomization$observed[[paired_name]] - fit$estimate,
             ri_statistic = randomization$observed[[test_name]],
             n_boot = as.integer(B_BOOT), n_perm = B_RI, n_undefined = 0L)
})
restricted_summary <- rbindlist(rows)
fwrite(restricted_summary, file.path(NUM_DIR, "restricted_results.csv"))
print(restricted_summary[, .(outcome, att, se, ri_p, stars, pre_mean, n_obs, n_cells)])
```

## Writing Table II and Appendix Tables B.3 and B.4

Writes the three table files (`tables/alloc_headline.tex`, `tables/appendix14_a1_allocation.tex`,
`tables/appendix14_a2_intake.tex`) and prints each table's numbers. The Observations rows count the
cell-years of 2012-2020: did keeps no cell-year of the last adoption group's year or later, when
every school-grade has adopted. Each count is checked against the cell-years of a fit. Also writes
`numbers/observations_estimate_years.csv` (each count, with the count over every year).

```{r paper-tables}
last_g <- max(CP$G)
est_years <- CP[yr < last_g]
obs_headline <- c(est_years[!is.na(gpa_z), .N], est_years[!is.na(sh_prio), .N])
# each count against the cell-years of a saved fit: Table II's against the event-study fits, which use
# the main estimates' cell-years (the main fits keep no fit object)
stopifnot("Table II, prior-year GPA: the cell-years of its fit" = obs_headline[1L] == nrow(j_g$fit$DIDparams$data),
          "Table II, low-income share: the cell-years of its fit" = obs_headline[2L] == nrow(j_p$fit$DIDparams$data))
obs_note <- sprintf(" Observations count the cell-years of %d--%d, the years the estimates use.", min(est_years$yr), max(est_years$yr))
tab <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\n   \\caption{Effect of Centralized Assignment (SAE) on Entering-Class Composition}",
  "\\label{tab: alloc headline}\n",
  "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{lcc}\n      \\toprule\n",
  "                   & Prior-year GPA (z) & Low-income share\\\\\n",
  "                   & (1) & (2)\\\\\n      \\midrule\n",
  row_tex("Effect of SAE", paste0(fmt(headline$att), star(headline$p_ri))),
  row_tex("", paste0("(", fmt(headline$se), ")")),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  row_tex("Mean (pre-treatment)", fmt(headline$pre_mean)),
  row_tex("Observations", format(obs_headline, big.mark = ",")),
  "      \\bottomrule\n   \\end{tabular}}}\n",
  "   \\par\\smallskip{\\footnotesize Notes: Region-clustered bootstrap SE in parentheses. ",
  "Stars from the randomization test of Section~\\ref{sec:allocation-inference}: $^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, ",
  "$^{*}$p$<$0.1. Mean (pre-treatment) averages the outcome over every cell-year ",
  "before the cell's adoption year.", obs_note, "}\n\\end{table}\n")
write_tex(tab, "alloc_headline.tex")
cat("Table II\n")
print(data.table(row = c("Effect of SAE", "", "Mean (pre-treatment)", "Observations"),
                 `Prior-year GPA (SD)` = c(paste0(fmt(headline$att[1L]), stars_text(headline$p_ri[1L])), paste0("(", fmt(headline$se[1L]), ")"),
                                           fmt(headline$pre_mean[1L]), format(obs_headline[1L], big.mark = ",")),
                 `Low-income share` = c(paste0(fmt(headline$att[2L]), stars_text(headline$p_ri[2L])), paste0("(", fmt(headline$se[2L]), ")"),
                                        fmt(headline$pre_mean[2L]), format(obs_headline[2L], big.mark = ","))))
```
