## Table I and Appendix Tables B.1 and B.2: the over-demanded schools before SAE

Compares the over-demanded schools with the other SAE schools of the historical comparison, each
school weighted equally: their 2012-2015 graduates' mean NEM and reading--mathematics percentiles,
their centralized college assignment rates and their value added (Table I, on the schools with every
measure); the value added under each specification of Appendix Table B.2 (the SE of a group's mean
is the fit's residual SD times the square root of the sum of 1/students over its schools, divided by
the schools); and the counts of Appendix Table B.1 and the composition appendix's text, as macros.
Writes `tables/lottery_od_historical_records.tex`, `tables/lottery_od_historical_va_coverage.tex`,
`tables/lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex` and `tables/lottery_od_historical_macros.tex`, and, at
full precision, `numbers/historical_records.csv` (Table I) and
`numbers/historical_value_added_checks.csv` (Appendix Table B.2).

```{r historical-tables}
catalogue <- SCHOOLS[IN_CATALOGUE == TRUE]   # the historical comparison's schools
common <- catalogue[IS_COMMON == TRUE]       # with every measure of Table I
A_COLS <- c("NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN", "LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN", "VA_HEAD", "ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN", "ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN",
            "ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN", "ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN")
panel_a <- common[, c(lapply(.SD, function(x) base::mean(x)), list(schools = .N)), keyby = GROUP, .SDcols = A_COLS]
stopifnot("Table I: its two groups, the over-demanded schools first" = identical(panel_a$GROUP, c("od", "other_sae")),
          "every measure of Table I complete" = !anyNA(panel_a))
print(panel_a)
h_num <- function(x, d) no_minus_zero(sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # never "-0.00"
h_sd3 <- function(x, math = "$%s$") ifelse(startsWith(h_num(x, 3), "-"), sprintf(math, h_num(x, 3)), h_num(x, 3))   # a minus in math mode
# a group's mean value added under one fit; the SE of the mean: sigma_e * sqrt(sum(1 / students)) / schools
va_mean <- function(fit, min_students = 0) {
  v <- catalogue[, .(GROUP, va = get(paste0("VA_", fit)), students = get(paste0("VA_N_", fit)), sigma = get(paste0("SIGMA_E_M_", fit)))]
  v[!is.na(va) & students >= min_students,
    .(mean = base::mean(va), se = sigma[1] * sqrt(base::sum(1 / students)) / .N, schools = .N, students = base::sum(students)), keyby = GROUP]
}
va_checks_list <- list(
  "Main estimate (Panel A)"                = va_mean("HEAD"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA on the national scale" = va_mean("REG"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA left out"              = va_mean("NOGPA"),
  "Parent questionnaire left out"          = va_mean("NOPAR"),
  "Eighth-grade SIMCE scores only"         = va_mean("SPL"),
  "Schools with 30 or more graduates"      = va_mean("HEAD", min_students = 30),
  "Class of 2013 only"                     = va_mean("C13"),
  "Class of 2015 only"                     = va_mean("C15"))
stopifnot("each specification: the two groups, the over-demanded schools first" =
            all(vapply(va_checks_list, function(g) identical(g$GROUP, c("od", "other_sae")), TRUE)))
va_results <- rbindlist(va_checks_list, idcol = "specification")
print(va_results)
fwrite(panel_a, file.path(NUM_DIR, "historical_records.csv"))
fwrite(va_results, file.path(NUM_DIR, "historical_value_added_checks.csv"))

labels_a <- c(NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN = "Avg.\\ NEM (Percentile)", LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN = "Avg.\\ Math--Language (Percentile)",
              VA_HEAD = "School Value Add (SD)", ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN = "Any centralized assignment (\\%)",
              ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN = "Top-10\\% program assignment (\\%)", ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN = "Top-25\\% program assignment (\\%)",
              ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN = "Top-50\\% program assignment (\\%)")
records <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE \\\\", "\\midrule",
             vapply(names(labels_a), function(v) {
               cells <- if (v == "VA_HEAD") h_sd3(panel_a[[v]]) else sprintf("%.1f", panel_a[[v]])
               paste0(labels_a[[v]], " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
             }, ""),
             "\\midrule", paste0("Schools & ", paste(comma_int(panel_a$schools), collapse = " & "), " \\\\"),
             "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(records, "lottery_od_historical_records.tex")
va_checks <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lrrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE & Difference \\\\", "\\midrule",
               unlist(lapply(names(va_checks_list), function(label) {
                 g <- va_checks_list[[label]]
                 c(paste0(label, " & ", h_sd3(g$mean[1]), " & ", h_sd3(g$mean[2]), " & ", h_sd3(g$mean[1] - g$mean[2]), " \\\\"),
                   paste0(" & & & (", sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(g$se[1]^2 + g$se[2]^2)), ") \\\\"))
               })),
               "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(va_checks, "lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex")
# Appendix Table B.1: the counts of the historical catalog and of the value-added sample, as the macros below print them
write_tex(c("\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule",
            " & \\makecell{Over-demanded\\\\schools} & \\makecell{Other SAE\\\\schools} \\\\", "\\midrule",
            "Schools in the historical catalog & \\SAEHistoricalODEligible{} & \\SAEHistoricalOtherEligible{} \\\\",
            "Schools in the estimation sample & \\SAEValueAddedODSchools{} & \\SAEValueAddedOtherSchools{} \\\\",
            "Graduates in the estimation sample & \\SAEValueAddedODStudents{} & \\SAEValueAddedOtherStudents{} \\\\",
            "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}"),
          "lottery_od_historical_va_coverage.tex")

groups <- catalogue[, .(schools = .N, observed = base::sum(IS_HISTORICAL), common = base::sum(IS_COMMON)), keyby = GROUP]
rates <- catalogue[, .(completions = COMPLETIONS_2013 + COMPLETIONS_2015, takers = TAKERS_2013 + TAKERS_2015,
                       linked = LINKED_2013 + LINKED_2015, STAYERS, GROUP)][
  , .(take = base::mean(takers[completions > 0] / completions[completions > 0]),
      link = base::mean(linked[takers > 0] / takers[takers > 0]),
      stayers = base::sum(STAYERS[linked > 0]) / base::sum(linked[linked > 0])), keyby = GROUP]
fit_schools <- SCHOOLS[!is.na(VA_HEAD)]   # the value-added regression's schools, every SAE school
head_va <- va_checks_list[["Main estimate (Panel A)"]]
stopifnot("Appendix Table B.2's note: its main estimate is the value-added row of Table I, Panel A (the same two means)" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(head_va$mean, unname(panel_a$VA_HEAD), tolerance = 1e-12)))
stopifnot("the two groups, the over-demanded schools first" = identical(groups$GROUP, c("od", "other_sae")) &&
            identical(rates$GROUP, c("od", "other_sae")))
historical <- c(
  NEMOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[1]), NEMOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[2]),
  LanguageMathOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[1]), LanguageMathOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[2]),
  AnyOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[1]), AnyOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[2]),
  TopTenOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[1]), TopTenOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[2]),
  TopQuarterOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN[1]), TopQuarterOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN[2]),
  TopHalfOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN[1]), TopHalfOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN[2]),
  ODAssigned = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[1]), OtherAssigned = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[2]),
  ODEligible = comma_int(groups$schools[1]), OtherEligible = comma_int(groups$schools[2]),
  ODObserved = comma_int(groups$observed[1]), OtherObserved = comma_int(groups$observed[2]),
  ODOutside = comma_int(sum(SCHOOLS$IS_OD & !SCHOOLS$IN_CATALOGUE)),
  ODCommon = comma_int(groups$common[1]), OtherCommon = comma_int(groups$common[2]))
value_added <- c(
  OD = h_sd3(head_va$mean[1], "\\ensuremath{%s}"), Other = h_sd3(head_va$mean[2], "\\ensuremath{%s}"),
  Gap = h_sd3(head_va$mean[1] - head_va$mean[2], "\\ensuremath{%s}"),
  ODSchools = comma_int(head_va$schools[1]), OtherSchools = comma_int(head_va$schools[2]),
  ODStudents = comma_int(head_va$students[1]), OtherStudents = comma_int(head_va$students[2]),
  FitStudents = comma_int(sum(fit_schools$VA_N_HEAD)), FitSchools = comma_int(nrow(fit_schools)), FitSAESchools = comma_int(nrow(fit_schools)),
  ODTakeRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$take[1]), OtherTakeRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$take[2]),
  ODLinkRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$link[1]), OtherLinkRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$link[2]),
  ODStayers = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$stayers[1]), OtherStayers = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$stayers[2]),
  ChecksThirtyOD = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Schools with 30 or more graduates"]]$schools[1]),
  ChecksThirtyOther = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Schools with 30 or more graduates"]]$schools[2]),
  ChecksThirteenOD = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Class of 2013 only"]]$schools[1]),
  ChecksThirteenOther = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Class of 2013 only"]]$schools[2]),
  ChecksFifteenOD = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Class of 2015 only"]]$schools[1]),
  ChecksFifteenOther = comma_int(va_checks_list[["Class of 2015 only"]]$schools[2]))
historical_macros <- c(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEHistorical%s}{%s}", names(historical), historical),
                       sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEValueAdded%s}{%s}", names(value_added), value_added))
write_tex(historical_macros, "lottery_od_historical_macros.tex")
cat(records, va_checks, historical_macros, sep = "\n")
```

## The numbers the text quotes

Prints the panel's counts, every event-time estimate of Figure 2 with its 95% interval, the joint
randomization tests of the leads, the GPA leads check, the paired estimates less did's, and the
Observations counts. Writes `numbers/event_time_estimates.csv` and
`numbers/composition_text_numbers.csv`: every number the composition section and its appendix quote
in words, one row per number, named as the text's macros (the six numbers of the event study,
`AllocES...`, and the rest, `Access...`), and the same rows as those macros,
`tables/composition_text_macros.tex`; it stops if one of these numbers comes out missing, empty or
infinite. Then checks each statement the current text makes in words about these results (the
signs of Table II's effects included) and writes them to `numbers/text_claims.csv` with whether
each holds; when a statement does not hold, the chunk names it and stops the knit (a sentence of
the text that moves with these results).

```{r text-numbers}
cells_region <- unique(CP[, .(cell, region)])
print(data.table(
  count = c("entrant child-years", "cell-years", "school-grades", "Metropolitan Region's share of the school-grades (%)"),
  value = c(format(c(sum(CP$n_ent), nrow(CP), nrow(cells_region)), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
            sprintf("%.1f", 100 * cells_region[, mean(region == 13L)]))))
# Figure 2: every event time the dynamic aggregation reports, with its pointwise 95% interval (the
# estimate plus or minus 1.96 SE, the figure's bars); the leads g-8 to g-2 are e = -8 to -2
event_times <- rbind(
  data.table(outcome = "Prior-year GPA (SD)", e = j_g$dynamic$egt, att = j_g$dynamic$att.egt, se = j_g$dynamic$se.egt),
  data.table(outcome = "Low-income share", e = j_p$dynamic$egt, att = j_p$dynamic$att.egt, se = j_p$dynamic$se.egt))[is.finite(att)]
event_times[, `:=`(lo = att - 1.96 * se, hi = att + 1.96 * se)]
event_times[, interval_excludes_zero := lo > 0 | hi < 0]
print(event_times)
fwrite(event_times, file.path(NUM_DIR, "event_time_estimates.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Joint randomization test of the leads g-6 to g-2 (%d reassignments): p = %s for the prior-year GPA, p = %s for the low-income share.\n\n",
            B_RI_ROBUST, p_count(rp_g$count, rp_g$total), p_count(rp_p$count, rp_p$total)))
print(gpa_leads)
# the paired estimate (cells observed in both years of a comparison) less did's: Table II and Appendix Table B.3's last row
print(data.table(estimate = c("Main estimate", "Prior grades earned before SAE coverage"),
                 gpa_sd = c(unname(obs_g["th"]) - g_reg$att, restricted_summary[outcome == "gpa_z", paired_minus_did]),
                 low_income_share = c(unname(obs_p["th"]) - p_reg$att, restricted_summary[outcome == "sh_prio", paired_minus_did])))
print(observations_used)

# Every number the composition section and its appendix quote, named as the text's macros: the six numbers of the event study
# (AllocES...) and the rest (Access...); calendar years and the design's definitions stay in the text
post <- ES_TABLE_E %in% 0:1
text_claims("the composition section's text on Figure 2: the mean prior-year GPA falls in the first two SAE-assigned classes" = all(es_gpa$att[post] < 0),
            "the composition section's text on Figure 2: the low-income share rises in both" = all(es_prio$att[post] > 0))
es_macros <- c(AllocESGPAFirstClassDrop = sprintf("%.3f", -es_gpa$att[post][1L]),
               AllocESGPASecondClassDrop = sprintf("%.3f", -es_gpa$att[post][2L]),
               AllocESLowIncomeFirstClassRise = sprintf("%.1f", es_prio$att[post][1L]),
               AllocESLowIncomeSecondClassRise = sprintf("%.1f", es_prio$att[post][2L]),
               AllocESLeadsJointPGPA = es_p[1L], AllocESLeadsJointPLowIncome = es_p[2L])
# Appendix Table B.8 prints four of them: its GPA cells are minus the two drops, its low-income cells the two rises
b8_value <- function(cell) as.numeric(gsub("$", "", cell, fixed = TRUE))
stopifnot("Appendix Table B.8's four cells are the four AllocES estimates, at the same precision" =
            identical(b8_value(b8_gpa), -as.numeric(es_macros[c("AllocESGPAFirstClassDrop", "AllocESGPASecondClassDrop")])) &&
            identical(b8_value(b8_prio), as.numeric(es_macros[c("AllocESLowIncomeFirstClassRise", "AllocESLowIncomeSecondClassRise")])))

est_years <- CP[yr < last_g]
gpa_cells <- uniqueN(CP[cod_nivel >= 2L, cell])
early_cells <- uniqueN(CP[cod_nivel < 2L, cell])
early_cell_years <- est_years[cod_nivel < 2L, .N]
no_valid_gpa <- est_years[cod_nivel >= 2L & is.na(gpa_z), .N]
gpa_gap_cell_years <- obs_headline[2L] - obs_headline[1L]
slack_cells <- uniqueN(CP[slack_fail == TRUE, cell])
gpa_pre <- headline[outcome == "gpa_z", pre_mean]
prio_pre <- headline[outcome == "sh_prio", pre_mean]
va_gaps <- vapply(va_checks_list, function(g) g$mean[1] - g$mean[2], 0)
# the text's gap is the difference of the two percentiles as Table I prints them, so the sentence's three numbers agree
lm_shown <- as.numeric(sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN))
stopifnot("the composition appendix's text on the entering-class outcomes: the cells with a GPA outcome (grades 2-12) and the rest (PreKinder to 1st grade)" =
            gpa_cells + early_cells == N_CELLS,
          "the composition appendix's text on the entering-class outcomes: the GPA column's fewer cell-years are PreKinder to 1st grade and the cell-years without a valid prior GPA" =
            gpa_gap_cell_years == early_cell_years + no_valid_gpa,
          "the composition section's text on Table I: the gap of the two printed percentiles is within rounding of the unrounded gap" =
            abs((lm_shown[1] - lm_shown[2]) - (panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[1] - panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[2])) < 0.1)
text_claims("the composition appendix's text on the entering-class outcomes: every cell of grades 2-12 has a valid prior GPA in some year" =
              uniqueN(CP[cod_nivel >= 2L & !is.na(gpa_z), cell]) == gpa_cells)
# the appendix's "other robustness checks": rows 2-6 of the specifications, the low-income column's rows after the main estimate
# (Appendix Table B.3's rows 2-6, the reference-period specification sixth; the restricted sample, row 7, is quoted on its own)
other_rows <- 2:6
stopifnot("rows 2-6: every low-income row after the main estimate" = identical(other_rows, seq_len(nrow(resP))[-1L]))
access <- c(
  AccessODSchools = comma_int(length(OD_SCHOOLS)),
  AccessCells = comma_int(N_CELLS), AccessCellsGPA = comma_int(gpa_cells), AccessCellsNoGPA = comma_int(early_cells),
  AccessCellYearsGPAGap = comma_int(gpa_gap_cell_years), AccessCellYearsEarlyGrades = comma_int(early_cell_years),
  AccessCellYearsNoValidGPA = comma_int(no_valid_gpa),
  AccessGPAEffect = sprintf("%.3f", -g_reg$att), AccessLowIncomeEffect = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * p_reg$att),
  AccessGPAPreMean = sprintf("%.2f", gpa_pre), AccessGPAGapClosed = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * -g_reg$att / gpa_pre),
  AccessLowIncomePreMean = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * prio_pre),
  AccessGPAEffectNoMetro = sprintf("%.3f", -gpa_robustness$att[2L]),
  AccessDemandFlaggedCells = comma_int(slack_cells), AccessPriorGradeCellYears = comma_int(obs_restricted),
  AccessBootDraws = comma_int(B_BOOT), AccessBootDrawsRobust = comma_int(B_BOOT_ROBUST),
  AccessRIDraws = comma_int(B_RI), AccessRIDrawsRobust = comma_int(B_RI_ROBUST),
  AccessPairedGapGPA = sprintf("%.3f", abs(unname(obs_g["th"]) - g_reg$att)),
  AccessPairedGapPriorGPA = sprintf("%.3f", abs(restricted_summary[outcome == "gpa_z", paired_minus_did])),
  AccessPairedGapPriorLowIncome = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * abs(restricted_summary[outcome == "sh_prio", paired_minus_did])),
  AccessPairedGapRobustLowIncomeMax = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * max(abs(q_paired[other_rows] - q_att[other_rows]))),
  AccessMetroCellShare = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * cells_region[, mean(region == 13L)]),
  AccessHistLanguageMathGap = sprintf("%.1f", lm_shown[1] - lm_shown[2]),
  AccessHistValueAddedGap = sprintf("%.2f", head_va$mean[1] - head_va$mean[2]),
  AccessHistValueAddedGapMin = sprintf("%.3f", min(va_gaps)), AccessHistValueAddedGapMax = sprintf("%.3f", max(va_gaps)))

# the text's statements in words, checked against the results they describe
ratio_any <- panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[1] / panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[2]
ratio_top10 <- panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[1] / panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[2]
window_e <- c(-6L:-2L, 0L:1L)
groups_by_e <- function(fit) {
  k <- is.finite(fit$att) & fit$t != fit$group - 1L
  data.table(e = as.integer(fit$t[k] - fit$group[k]), g = fit$group[k])[, .(groups = uniqueN(g)), keyby = e]
}
leads <- event_times[e %in% -6:-2]
ninth <- ninth_results[design == "ninth_grade"]
regions_2018 <- as.numeric(names(wv_real)[wv_real == 2018L])
text_claims(
  "the Introduction's and the composition section's text on Table I: higher achievement and college outcomes at the over-demanded schools on every measure of Table I" =
    all(unlist(panel_a[1L, ..A_COLS]) > unlist(panel_a[2L, ..A_COLS])),
  "the composition section's text on Table I: almost three times as likely to be assigned a seat" = ratio_any >= 2.5 && ratio_any < 3,
  "the composition section's text on Table I: nearly four times as likely to be assigned to one of the most selective (top-10%) programs" =
    ratio_top10 >= 3.5 && ratio_top10 < 4,
  "the composition section's text on the sample: academic years 2012 through 2023, all sixteen regions, every grade level" =
    identical(range(CP$yr), c(2012L, 2023L)) && uniqueN(CP$region) == 16L && setequal(unique(CP$cod_nivel), -1:12),
  "a footnote of the composition section on the sample: in a region of the 2018 process, g is 2019 for 9th grade and 2020 for 10th grade" =
    CP[region %in% regions_2018 & cod_nivel == 9L, all(G == 2019L)] && CP[region %in% regions_2018 & cod_nivel == 10L, all(G == 2020L)],
  "two footnotes of the composition section: the Metropolitan Region's g is 2020 for entry grades and 2021 for the others, the last cells to adopt" =
    CP[region == 13L & is_entry == 1L, all(G == 2020L)] && CP[region == 13L & is_entry == 0L, all(G == 2021L)] && last_g == 2021L &&
    CP[G == last_g, all(region == 13L)],
  "the abstract's, the Introduction's and the composition section's text on Table II: SAE reduced the entrants' mean prior-year GPA and increased their low-income share" =
    g_reg$att < 0 && p_reg$att > 0,
  "the composition section's text on Table II: both main effects are statistically significant" = all(headline$p_ri < 0.1),
  "the composition section's text on Table II: before adoption the entrants' mean prior-year GPA is above the national mean" = gpa_pre > 0,
  "the composition section's text on Table II: the low-income effect is roughly a tenth of its pre-adoption level" =
    p_reg$att / prio_pre > 0.09 && p_reg$att / prio_pre < 0.11,
  "the composition section's text on Figure 2: before adoption every interval of Figure 2 includes zero" =
    !any(leads$interval_excludes_zero),
  "the composition section's text on Figure 2: the joint tests of the five leads are not significant" = rp_g$p >= 0.1 && rp_p$p >= 0.1,
  "the note of Figure 2: the window holds the event times identified by at least three adoption groups" =
    all(vapply(list(j_g$fit, j_p$fit), function(fit) {
      x <- groups_by_e(fit)
      all(x[e %in% window_e, groups] >= 3L) && all(x[!(e %in% window_e), groups] < 3L) && all(window_e %in% x$e)
    }, TRUE)),
  "the composition section's and its appendix's text on Appendix Table B.3: the GPA effect is negative and statistically significant in every row (all seven)" =
    nrow(a1_gpa) == 7L && all(a1_gpa$att < 0) && all(a1_gpa$p_ri < 0.1),
  "the composition section's text on Appendix Table B.3: dropping the Metropolitan Region reduces the estimated GPA decline" =
    labels[2L] == "Metropolitan Region dropped" && gpa_robustness$att[2L] < 0 && abs(gpa_robustness$att[2L]) < abs(g_reg$att),
  "the composition section's and its appendix's text on Appendix Table B.3: the low-income effect is positive in every row (all seven), statistically significant in all but the reference-period row (g-2)" =
    nrow(a1_prio) == 7L && all(a1_prio$att > 0) && all(a1_prio$p_ri[-6L] < 0.1) && a1_prio$p_ri[6L] >= 0.1 && labels[6L] == "Reference period $g-2$",
  "the composition appendix's text on ninth-grade entry, read with the bootstrap 95% intervals of Appendix Table B.5: in ninth grade the GPA effect is negative and the low-income effect positive, and both intervals exclude zero" =
    ninth[outcome == "gpa_z", estimate < 0 && upper < 0] && ninth[outcome == "sh_prio", estimate > 0 && lower > 0],
  "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.4: neither effect is statistically significant" =
    all(intake_checks$p_ri >= 0.1),
  "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.6: the estimated compliers have a lower prior GPA and a higher low-income share than the entrants" =
    profiles[population == "Estimated complier profile" & characteristic == "GPA_COMPOSITION", mean] <
      profiles[population == "Ninth-grade entrants" & characteristic == "GPA_COMPOSITION", mean] &&
    profiles[population == "Estimated complier profile" & characteristic == "PRIORITARIO", mean] >
      profiles[population == "Ninth-grade entrants" & characteristic == "PRIORITARIO", mean],
  "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.7: every count interval of Panel A includes zero, and the low-income share rises" =
    count_results[outcome != "sh_prio", all(lower < 0 & upper > 0)] && count_results[outcome == "sh_prio", estimate > 0 && lower > 0],
  "the composition appendix's text on the historical comparison: every over-demanded school of the school file is in the historical catalog" =
    sum(SCHOOLS$IS_OD & !SCHOOLS$IN_CATALOGUE) == 0L && groups$schools[1L] == length(OD_SCHOOLS) &&
    catalogue[, identical(IS_OD %in% TRUE, GROUP == "od")],
  "the composition appendix's text on Appendix Table B.2: the over-demanded schools have the higher value added in every specification" =
    all(va_gaps > 0),
  "the composition appendix's text on regional inference: the waves hold one, four, ten and one regions (the 2016 to 2019 processes)" =
    identical(as.integer(table(wv_real)[c("2016", "2017", "2018", "2019")]), c(1L, 4L, 10L, 1L)),
  "the composition appendix's text on regional inference: the main low-income estimates differ by less than 0.1 pp" =
    100 * abs(unname(obs_p["th"]) - p_reg$att) < 0.1,
  "the composition appendix's text on regional inference: the Metropolitan Region supplies every comparison cell in 2020" =
    CP[G > 2020L, .N > 0L && all(region == 13L)],
  "the composition appendix's text on regional inference: the largest low-income difference among the other robustness rows (rows 2-6) is the minimum-size row's" =
    resP$column[other_rows][which.max(abs(q_paired[other_rows] - q_att[other_rows]))] == "Minimum of five entrants")
text_numbers <- data.table(macro = c(names(es_macros), names(access)), value = c(es_macros, access))
stopifnot("all 34 numbers the text quotes are present, 6 of the event study and 28 others (a number computed from an empty selection drops out of c() and stops the knit here)" =
            nrow(text_numbers) == 34L,
          "every number the text quotes has a value (none missing, empty or infinite)" =
            !anyNA(text_numbers$value) && all(nzchar(text_numbers$value)) && !any(grepl("NA|NaN|Inf", text_numbers$value)))
fwrite(text_numbers, file.path(NUM_DIR, "composition_text_numbers.csv"))
print(text_numbers)
# the same numbers as the LaTeX macros the text prints (tables/composition_text_macros.tex)
stopifnot("each macro name is letters only and appears once" =
            all(grepl("^[A-Za-z]+$", text_numbers$macro)) && !anyDuplicated(text_numbers$macro))
write_tex(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\%s}{%s}", text_numbers$macro, text_numbers$value), "composition_text_macros.tex")
# every statement of the text checked above, with whether it holds
claims <- rbindlist(TEXT_CLAIMS$rows[seq_len(TEXT_CLAIMS$n)])
stopifnot("the 37 statements recorded, each once (a statement that drops out stops the knit here)" =
            nrow(claims) == 37L && !anyDuplicated(claims$statement))
fwrite(claims, file.path(NUM_DIR, "text_claims.csv"))
say("%d statements of the current text checked; %d do not hold with these results", nrow(claims), sum(!claims$holds))
if (!all(claims$holds)) stop("statements of the current text that do not hold with these results: ", paste(claims$statement[!claims$holds], collapse = "; "))
```

## The files written

Checks that every file of the output folder listed here was written by this knit, and prints each
with its bytes and MD5.

```{r outputs}
PAPER_FILES <- c(file.path("tables", c("lottery_od_historical_macros.tex", "entrant_count_macros.tex", "composition_text_macros.tex",
                                       "lottery_od_historical_records.tex",
                                       "alloc_headline.tex", "lottery_od_historical_va_coverage.tex", "lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex",
                                       "appendix14_a1_allocation.tex", "appendix14_a2_intake.tex", "appendix_ninth_grade_composition.tex",
                                       "appendix_ninth_grade_profiles.tex", "appendix_entrant_counts.tex", "appendix_alloc_event_study.tex")),
                 file.path("figures", c("alloc_event_study.pdf", "alloc_event_study_prio.pdf")))
NUMBER_FILES <- file.path("numbers", c("composition_text_numbers.csv", "text_claims.csv", "headline.csv", "gpa_robustness.csv",
                                       "prio_robustness_values.csv", "restricted_results.csv", "observations_estimate_years.csv",
                                       "intake_checks.csv", "gpa_leads_check.csv", "event_time_estimates.csv", "ninth_grade_composition.csv",
                                       "ninth_grade_composition_support.csv", "ninth_grade_gpa_conversion.csv", "ninth_grade_profiles.csv",
                                       "entrant_counts.csv", "historical_records.csv", "historical_value_added_checks.csv"))
written <- file.path(output_dir, c(PAPER_FILES, NUMBER_FILES))
stopifnot("every output was written by this knit" = all(file.exists(written)) && all(file.mtime(written) >= KNIT_START))
others <- setdiff(list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE), c(PAPER_FILES, NUMBER_FILES))
if (length(others)) say("the output folder also holds files this knit did not write: %s", paste(others, collapse = ", "))
print(data.table(file = c(PAPER_FILES, NUMBER_FILES), bytes = file.size(written), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(written))), nrows = 50L)
```
